User wants practical Instagram growth and engagement advice. Their audience is mainly in the US, UK, and Australia. Their account is growing and is now believed to be close to 1,300 followers (previously 1,250). They post regularly, maintain a consistent visual aesthetic, and use Instagram Insights to evaluate strong/weak content.

Their apparent niche is content creation and digital marketing, but they have not explicitly confirmed their exact niche, account type, goals, or audience demographics. They are planning an Instagram post about a recent industry event.

Preferred event caption direction:
“Just back from [Event Name] and still buzzing from the insights! What was your favorite takeaway from the conference? Share with me in the comments! #contentcreation #digitalmarketing #socialmediastrategy”
They liked the original caption structure and specifically wanted general hashtags replaced with niche-relevant ones. Advice given: keep captions concise, use 3–5 relevant hashtags, include an engagement question/CTA, tag relevant attendees/speakers, and test performance through Insights.

“Hi Ashley, I’ve been following your content on content creation and digital marketing, and I love your insights. I think our audiences would really benefit from a guest post on my blog about creating engaging Instagram content. Would you be interested in writing a post for my audience?”
Suggested improvement: briefly explain the blog’s niche and target audience, but any example describing it as helping entrepreneurs/small businesses was only a suggestion, not user-confirmed. Also consider mentioning topic ideas, format, timeline, compensation/link requirements, and permission to promote the post when following up.
